publication.title: CamTrapAsia: A dataset of tropical forest vertebrate communities from 239 camera trapping studies

published_summary.geographic_scope: Indonesia, Singapore, Malaysia, Bhutan, Thailand, Myanmar, Cambodia, Laos, Vietnam, Nepal and far eastern India; NOT nine independent island archipelagos

exact_required_file_metadata.likely_role: site/trap study metadata, no assertion of independent island identity
species names and traits, not independent island-level detection
published camera detection counts; DO NOT READ

research_intent.first_test: Does a truly recorded field camera study provide sufficient original heldout island centroids across more than one spatial block and overlapping original 529 species names?
research_intent.order: Frozen public file metadata -> safe field names -> site-only georeference -> taxon name overlap -> exact island identity -> detection effort -> separately admitted species outcome
research_intent.not_established: Any station lies on a separately named oceanic island, even when the study is from Indonesia/Malaysia; 239 studies are not 239 independent island replicates
